Name: Starblue Valley Alternate Config
Author: ErusPrime
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿ is a fantastic visual overhaul of the game. I also really like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5171]Magica Trees[/url]﻿. Unfortunately, Starblue Valley doesn't have a config option to use other trees. So I added one.

Installation:
Replace content.json in Starblue Valley folder.

And that's it. Now you can use "none" as a config option for the trees and install any content patcher tree replacement your heart desires.
